titleEn: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
summary: Rod's Titan reaches Orvud. The corps breaks him on the wall, and Historia takes the last blow in front of the people.

segments.ja: オルブド区の人は、いつもどおり門の内側で朝を始めます。始める人に、這ってくる熱はまだ見えません。見えない熱を、調査兵団は壁の上で待っています。待つ計画は、巨人を内側の家に入れないことです。入れないために、住民は壁の上へ誘導されます。誘導は、避難に見せた戦闘です。戦闘の中身を、人はまだ知りません。知らない人の頭上で、桶が並びます。
segments.en: The people of Orvud District start the morning inside the gate as usual. The heat crawling toward them is not yet visible to the people who start it. The Survey Corps is waiting for the invisible heat on the wall. The plan of waiting is not to let the Titan into the houses inside. To not let it in, the residents are guided up onto the wall. The guidance is a fight shown as an evacuation. The people do not yet know the contents of the fight. Above the heads of the people who do not know, barrels are lined up.

tokens.note: A district on Wall Sina. Rod's Titan crawls toward it. The district that will burn if the crawling Titan is allowed over the wall.

segments.ja: ロッドの巨人は、言葉も顔の形も失った熱です。失った熱が、壁に体を預けます。預けた体は、通常のうなじの位置を持ちません。持たない相手に、刃の基本は通用しません。通用しない報告を、エルヴィンは火薬の量で受けます。受ける計画は、体を壁の上で爆砕し、中の人間を露出させることです。露出した一点を、最後に断ちます。断つ役が、ヒストリアです。その配置は、城壁の上で一度だけ見直されます。見直した目が、次の桶の角度を決めます。
segments.en: Rod's Titan is a heat that has lost both words and the shape of a face. The heat it lost leans its body on the wall. The body it leaned does not have the usual place of a nape. The basics of a blade do not work on an opponent that does not have it. Erwin receives the report that does not work as a quantity of powder. The plan he receives is to blast the body apart on the wall and expose the human inside. The exposed point is cut last. The role of cutting is Historia. That arrangement is looked over once on top of the wall. The eyes that looked it over decide the next barrel's angle.

segments.ja: 壁の上から、火薬の桶が熱の背中へ落ちます。落ちる音は、街の朝を一度で戦争にします。戦争の風が、住民の列を押します。押されても、人は壁から降りられません。降りられないことが、作戦の残酷さです。残酷さを、リヴァイは必要だと割り切ります。割り切った必要の中で、エレンが拳を加えます。加える拳が、爆砕の角度を父の体の中心へ寄せます。
segments.en: From the top of the wall, barrels of powder fall onto the heat's back. The sound of falling makes the town's morning into a war all at once. The wind of the war pushes the residents' line. Even pushed, the people cannot get down from the wall. Not being able to get down is the cruelty of the operation. Levi writes the cruelty off as necessary. Inside the necessity he wrote off, Eren adds a fist. The fist he adds draws the angle of the blast toward the center of the father's body.

segments.ja: エレンは、罪の記憶を持ったまま熱に入ります。入る拳は、償いで死ぬ拳ではありません。ヒストリアの刃が届く穴を開ける拳です。開けることに、彼は父の名を叫びません。叫ばない集中が、角度を正確にします。正確な角度が、巨大な肉を壁の上で割ります。割れた肉の中から、人間の核が飛びます。飛ぶ核を、最後に受ける位置へ彼女が入ります。
segments.en: Eren enters the heat while still holding the memory of sin. The fist that enters is not a fist that dies as repayment. It is a fist that opens a hole Historia's blade can reach. He does not shout his father's name at the opening. The concentration that does not shout makes the angle exact. The exact angle splits the huge flesh on the wall. From inside the split flesh, a human core flies. She enters the place that receives the flying core last.

segments.ja: ヒストリアは、住民の見える位置で刃を振ります。振る理由は、父を隠れた場所で消さないためです。ためです、という公開が、後の女王の最初の政治です。政治を、彼女は計算としては持っていません。持っていないまま、父の核を断ちます。断つ手が、子供の無視を終わらせます。終わらせた場面を、街の人は巨人を倒した兵士として見ます。見る理解は、まだ半分です。半分でも、彼女の名は通りに落ちます。
segments.en: Historia swings the blade in a place the residents can see. The reason she swings it is not to erase her father in a hidden place. The publication of that purpose is the first politics of the later queen. She does not hold the politics as a calculation. Without holding it, she cuts her father's core. The hand that cuts ends the neglect of a child. The people of the town see the scene she ended as a soldier who brought down a Titan. The understanding they see is still half. Even half, her name falls into the street.

segments.ja: ロッドは、這う神としては死にます。死ぬ瞬間に、娘への使命の声はもうありません。ない声の代わりに、肉が壁の上へ散ります。散ったあと、ヒストリアは刃を下ろします。下ろした顔は、勝利の笑顔ではありません。ではありませんが、否の続きを完了した顔です。完了を、エレンは隣で見ます。見る隣人が、食べられる対象ではなくなったことを、二人は同時に知ります。爆風のあと、屋根の埃がもう一回落ちます。落ちた埃の下で、手順は続きました。
segments.en: Rod dies as a crawling god. At the moment of dying, the voice of mission toward his daughter is already gone. In place of the voice that is gone, flesh scatters onto the wall. After it scatters, Historia lowers the blade. The face that lowered it is not a smile of victory. Even so, it is a face that completed the continuation of the no. Eren watches the completion beside her. The two of them know at the same time that the neighbor he watches is no longer a thing to be eaten. After the blast, dust falls from the roof one more time. Under the dust that fell, the procedure continued.

segments.ja: オルブドの人は、壁の上の少女の名を尋ねます。尋ねる声に、彼女はクリスタとは答えません。答えは、ヒストリア・レイスです。レイスの名が、通りで王の血として響きます。響く血を、彼女は隠す役に戻しません。戻さない宣言が、外壁の上で行われます。行われた場所が、この回の題です。題の下で、人は助かった事実と、新しい名を一緒に持ちます。
segments.en: The people of Orvud ask the name of the girl on the wall. She does not answer Christa to the voice that asks. The answer is Historia Reiss. The name Reiss sounds in the street as royal blood. She does not return the blood that sounds to a role of hiding. The declaration of not returning is made on the outer wall. The place it was made is the title of this episode. Under the title, the people hold together the fact of having been saved and the new name.

segments.en: After the fight, Erwin sets the talk of the basement back on the table. The condition of setting it is that politics inside the walls does not stop the survey. The face of the politics that does not stop is today's Historia. If Historia becomes queen, they can send the army of the retaking. Ahead of the army they can send are Shiganshina and Grisha's house. The reason for the judgment is that the crawling father was first. Now that what was first is finished, Kenny remains scattered. He does not close today the past that remains scattered. The center of the report he does not close is that Historia cut her father in front of people. The fact of the cutting is the core of the next politics.

The sketch of the weapon that is not enough is a note before the thunder spears. The note is still paper today. Ahead of the paper, the fight outside the walls is reserved. The barrels that remain are still hot. The squad steps over the heat they hold and goes on.
